text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eep! I give in! I'm way too ticklish for
this!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh! Yeah, this is too much for me to
handle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after classes are finished, I see
a group
of students intertwining their
tails.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It seems the breath of revelry has been
blowing
through the entire academy
since this morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature and Ikuno Dictus happen to
walk by
at that very moment, so we
decide to ask them.
choice_data_list: 誰かに事情を聞いてみようか

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, last night was the final episode of Friendly Love, so people can't stop talking about it today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Friendly Love is a teen drama about Umamusume attending a fictional high school. I often hear students having excited discussions about it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I mean, I'm not even a superfan
like
everyone else is, but that finale had
my heart
skipping beats.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I never expected them to take their tails
and—no,
I can't even say it. My chest
tightens at the mere
memory of it...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Have the dark winds taken hold of you,
Ikuno? I
hope you feel better soon.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Don't worry. There's nothing wrong
with me.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It was just kinda shocking is all! Buuut
also kinda
heartwarming too?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Like taking a deep breath in the woods,
letting
the verdant breeze fill your
lungs?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, I guess you could describe
it...
something like that?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I must admit, I'm suddenly quite curious
about
this tail-related act. Will you
teach me how to do
it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uhh... Ikuno! Why don't you
explain it? I'm
feeling way too bashful
here!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You want me to do it?! ...Ahem. A-all right.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The act involves touching your tails
together and
then wrapping them
around each other twice...
Th-that's it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fascinating... So like this?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a second, Zephyr! Are you
attempting to
try it with me?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Is there something wrong with that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Th-there's nothing wrong with it, but... uhh, you can't just up and do it with someone! Not out of the blue!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In the show, the characters only did tail
hugs with
a special someone. You know,
like a... partner? A
special partner!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A special partner...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh. Well, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwoosh! Fwoosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like something soft is caressing my
back!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hm... That felt something like... a mellow
breeze...
or still serenity, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I suppose two tails are necessary to
experience
the verdant breeze at its
most invigorating.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr seems to have
misunderstood
what hugging tails is
actually about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The faces of everyone watching turn
bright red
after witnessing her bold
gesture.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Although... Hehe. By no means did that
feel
unpleasant. Would you mind trying
it with me one
more—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! Yes, let's go.
choice_data_list: ゼファー、そろそろトレーニングに行こう！
（今後のために根気よく事実を伝える）

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
How tactful. It certainly helps to have an
adult
around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training vigorously, Yamanin
Zephyr makes
noticeable progress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I carefully explain to Yamanin Zephyr
what a tail
hug really means.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I was sure that, um... Oh...
